Fit Bayesian PCA Imputation at a Tuned Rank

Source: R/mi_pca_tune.R
mipca_fit.Rd

Fit mipca() at a rank from a mipca_tune() table, with the nu, transform and sampler settings of that tuning run.

Usage

mipca_fit(
  object,
  obj,
  rank = NULL,
  ...,
  chains,
  iter_warmup,
  iter_sampling,
  thin,
  spectra,
  init,
  refresh = 100L,
  keep_state = FALSE,
  prop_diag = 0.5,
  seed = NULL,
  nu = NULL,
  transform,
  abb
)

Arguments

object

A si_tune object. The table mipca_tune() returns, or a subset of its rows.

obj

A double matrix. The matrix object was tuned on, passed again. The table does not carry it.

rank

Integer or NULL. A rank in object. With NULL, the rank with the lowest crps. Defaults to NULL.

...

Not used. Name every argument after rank.

chains

Integer. Number of independent chains. Taken from object when left out.

iter_warmup

Integer. Number of iterations discarded at the start of each chain, 0 or more. Taken from object when left out.

iter_sampling

Integer. Number of draws kept per chain. Taken from object when left out.

thin

Integer. After warmup, each chain keeps one iteration in every thin, as in mipca(). Taken from object when left out.

spectra

A spectra_opts object. Settings for the eigensolver, from spectra_opts(). Taken from object when left out.

init

Numeric. How widely each chain's starting values are spread, as in mipca(). Taken from object when left out.

refresh

Integer. Print a progress line every refresh iterations of each chain, or 0 for none. Defaults to 100.

keep_state

Logical. If TRUE, return a fit that update() can extend at the cost of memory. Defaults to FALSE.

prop_diag

Numeric scalar between 0 and 1. Proportion of each column's missing values on which summary() computes Rhat and ESS. 0 is refused. Defaults to 0.5.

seed

Integer, numeric, or NULL. Seed for the sampler. With NULL, the seed is drawn from R's random number stream. Defaults to NULL.

nu

Numeric or NULL. Degrees of freedom of the noise drawn for a missing value, as in mipca(). With NULL, the implied_nu of rank in object, or 5 if it is lower. Defaults to NULL.

transform, abb

Not used. The fit uses the transform and abb stored in object. To change them, run mipca_tune() again, or call mipca().

Value

As mipca(): with keep_state = FALSE, a finalized fit of class si_mi. With keep_state = TRUE, a resumable fit of class si_mi_pca.

Details

The matrix. obj must be the same matrix object was tuned on. Another matrix is refused. The held-out values are not held out in the fit: every observed value of obj is used.

The rank and nu. With rank = NULL, the rank is the one with the lowest crps among the ranks whose fit did not fail. A given rank must be in object. When the implied_nu is below 5, the fit uses 5 and a message says so. A nu that is given is used as it is, with the warning mipca() gives below 5.

The same fit as mipca(). The fit is the one mipca() returns for the same obj, rank, nu, transform, abb, sampler settings and seed.

See also

  • mipca_tune() to make the table.

  • mipca() to fit with a rank and nu of your own.

Examples

set.seed(1)
sim <- sim_mat(n = 50, p = 20, beta = TRUE)
tuned <- mipca_tune(
  sim$input,
  rank = 1:3,
  transform = "logit_biwhiten",
  n_cols = 10,
  seed = 1
)

# The rank with the lowest crps
fit <- mipca_fit(tuned, sim$input, refresh = 0, seed = 1)
#> the implied nu at rank 1 is 2.6, under the floor of 5, so the fit uses nu = 5. Pass 'nu' to use another value
fit
#> si_mi fit: 50 x 20, 100 imputed cells, 400 draws
#>   next: as.matrix() with 'draw' for a completed matrix, summary() for Rhat and ESS

# Another tuned rank, with more draws per chain
fit3 <- mipca_fit(tuned, sim$input, rank = 3, iter_sampling = 200, refresh = 0, seed = 1)
#> the implied nu at rank 3 is 3.41, under the floor of 5, so the fit uses nu = 5. Pass 'nu' to use another value
